name: com.unity.microsoft.gdk.discovery
description: This package provides APIs which can be used for the discovery of local Microsoft GDK SDKs, and related SDKs.

samples.description: Adds new Editor menu items which demonstrate using the GDK Discovery API to find local Microsoft GDK installations.

_upm.changelog:
### Added
- Added support for the new October 25 GDK layout for building witout an installed (BWOI) GDK.
